classification.interval: each instrument: lower = the program's dual bound (its optimum when optimal), or the search's d when complete, or at a time-out the largest bound of a pass that found nothing (1 if none); upper = its checked witness's weight; an entry's interval is the intersection
classification.known answers (d): reproduced (the interval is the registered d), consistent but unresolved (it holds the registered d and more), contradicted (it excludes it), method error, not tested (no instrument gave a result); a contradiction or a method error fails the instruments, the known d having been reproduced before
classification.method error: an instrument found logicals != bb.k_linalg, ended with a status other than exact or a limit, or returned a witness that fails verify_witness (or none with an exact value); or the intervals do not meet
classification.program against search (c): agree (all three exact), consistent (one at a limit; the intervals meet), disagree (two intervals do not meet), method error, not tested (an instrument's job failed); (c) can show a program fault only where a search completes, since an optimum above d lies within the intervals of searches stopped at their limits below it
classification.protocol: every record's l and m are its job's (or its entry's), a toric record holds the toric code, the programs of (a), (b) and (f) ran at the registered seeds, every program with SCIP_FIX in its settings ((f)'s control without it), every search deepening, from its instrument's anchors; otherwise the record fails
classification.verdict: hold when (a), (b), (c), (e) and (f) pass, no entry of (d) is a method error or contradicted, and every record follows the protocol; fail when any of them fails, or a record's code differs from the registration; incomplete when jobs are missing and nothing failed

body.statement: After examples/qec-distance found a wrong optimum from SCIP 10.0 and two stalls of the search, distance.distance_ilp runs SCIP with SCIP_FIX and distance.distance_search deepens its bound. (a) On 50 fresh codes at 2x13 and 3x9, both equal the enumeration (the program at 5 seeds, both kinds); (c) on 14 fresh trinomial codes at 7 reserved sizes (n = 96 to 210; of the published form at 3x28 and 7x15, of weight 3 elsewhere), the intervals of the program and of the search from every qubit and from (0, lm) meet, with 20-minute limits, and the search completes on every one; (e) both give min(l, m) on the toric code at 6 new sizes; (f) on 142 fresh structured codes with k >= 4 at the 6 other reserved small sizes (n = 56 to 80), of the families where SCIP's defaults failed, the program at 20 seeds, both kinds, equals the search from every qubit, while SCIP's defaults, run beside it as an unjudged control, are wrong at least once. (b) The 38 codes on which SCIP's defaults failed give the right d at seeds 0 to 19, and (d) the 12 published entries and the 2 stalled codes give their known d: regressions on known answers, not blind.
